html:
The movement of Austronesian speaking farmers and seafarers from Taiwan south into the Philippines, around 2200 BCE. On the chart it marks the first step of the greatest sea migration before modern times.

The settlers brought red-slipped pottery, rice, pigs and outrigger canoes. Taiwan still has the most varied Austronesian languages, among its indigenous peoples, which is why most scholars place the homeland there. The arrival in the islands is also on the chart as Austronesians reach the Philippines.

From the Philippines their descendants spread over the following millennia:

  • south into Indonesia and Malaysia
  • east to the islands of the Pacific, with the Lapita voyagers after about 1600 BCE
  • across the Indian Ocean to Madagascar in the first millennium CE
  • to Hawaii, New Zealand and Rapa Nui, with the settlement of East Polynesia

Today Austronesian languages are spoken from Madagascar to Rapa Nui.
sum: The movement of Austronesian speaking farmers and seafarers from Taiwan south into the Philippines, around 2200 BCE. On the chart it marks the first step of the greatest sea migration before modern times.
